data.text: React Router is the standard routing library for React. It enables client-side routing in single-page applications, allowing navigation between views without full page reloads. It supports dynamic routes, nested routes, and programmatic navigation.

data.title: Setting Up Routes

terms.definition: A mapping between a URL path and a React component to render.
A URL parameter in the path, e.g., /users/:id captures the id from the URL.

data.title: Key Takeaways
points: Supports dynamic routes, nested routes, and loaders
v6+ uses data routers with createBrowserRouter
data.takeaway: React Router is essential for building multi-page experiences in React SPAs.
